llm.summary: This skill is a disclosed paid API wrapper for cosmetic ingredient compliance checks, with no bundled executable code or hidden persistence.

dimensions.detail: The skill sends ingredient lists to an external service and uses an x402 payment signature, which is proportionate to a paid compliance API but should be considered before submitting proprietary formulas.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The artifact is a single Markdown skill file with frontmatter metadata and no install scripts, dependencies, or executable components.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Instructions are scoped to when to use the service, request format, authentication options, response handling, and payment errors; no prompt override, self-modification, or unrelated agent behavior is present.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No cross-session persistence, local credential harvesting, tool wrapping, background workers, or privilege escalation instructions were found.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The documented capability matches the stated purpose: send cosmetic ingredients and target markets to a compliance endpoint and return EU CosIng-style restriction results.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Before installing, understand that each check is a paid external API call and that submitted ingredient lists may reveal proprietary formulation information. Use it for screening, but verify regulatory conclusions independently before making legal or market-access decisions.
